subject: Request: vulnerability assessment report — controlled access & summary
messages:
From: Alyssa Grant <alyssa.grant@fintechcorp.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: security@fintechcorp.com
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vulnerability assessment report request (FintechCorp)

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for taking the call yesterday. Our InfoSec team has asked for the full vulnerability assessment (penetration test) report that Redwood commissioned in June. They need the findings, risk severity, and proof of remediation for items labeled critical/high for our internal audit.

Can you share the full report PDF plus any remediation evidence? If full disclosure isn't possible, please explain what you can provide and whether an on-site or controlled on-screen review is an option. Also let us know if we need to sign an NDA or use a remote review portal.

We'd like to close this before our audit kickoff the week of Aug 9.

Best,
Alyssa
Head of Information Security
FintechCorp

From: soojin_lee@redwood.com <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Grant <alyssa.grant@fintechcorp.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 12:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vulnerability assessment report request (FintechCorp)

Alyssa —

Appreciate the heads up. Short answer: we cannot share the full raw penetration test report outside of controlled review due to third-party tester TOS and to protect red-team tooling details. That said, we can provide the following to meet your audit needs:  

- Executive vulnerability summary (attached) that maps each finding to severity, affected components, and mitigation status.
- Remediation evidence for all Critical and High items (screenshots, ticket links, patch notes) consolidated into a remediation tracker (attached).
- Option for a 60-minute controlled on-screen review where a Redwood security engineer (Hannah) walks your InfoSec through findings in real time; session recorded only if both parties agree in writing.
- We can also execute a short standard NDA if your legal team prefers.

Attachments: vuln-report-summary.pdf, remediation_tracker.xlsx. I've redacted low-level exploit PoCs and internal IPs per our redaction policy. If you need additional context mapping to SOC 2 control IDs, we can provide that separately.

Next steps: please confirm (a) whether you want the on-screen review and preferred window the week of Aug 2 or (b) if the summary + remediation tracker suffice for the audit. We'll route anything additional through legal as needed.

Thanks,
Sojin Lee
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
(415) 555-9221

From: security@fintechcorp.com <security@fintechcorp.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: Alyssa Grant <alyssa.grant@fintechcorp.com>, procurement@fintechcorp.com
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vulnerability assessment report request (FintechCorp)

Sojin,

Thanks for the quick reply. The summary and remediation tracker look like a good start. A few clarifying asks from our auditors:  

- We need to see remediation timestamps and Jira/ticket IDs for each high/critical item. Can you ensure the tracker includes ticket links or at least ticket IDs?
- For any items still in progress, what is the projected completion date?
- We'd prefer an on-screen review for anything labeled Critical. Please propose 2x 60-minute slots (PST) next week.

Also, our legal is prepared to sign an NDA; they asked if your NDA template is attached. If you could send a draft (or confirm you'd accept our standard mutual NDA) that would speed the process.

Regards,
FintechCorp Security Team


From: monica_patel@redwood.com <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Cc: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 10:01:00 -07:00
Subject: FW: Vulnerability assessment report request (FintechCorp)

Sojin / Vivek —

Looping in Hannah from Security to prepare the controlled review and collect ticket evidence. Hannah — we should prepare:  

1) remediation_tracker.xlsx with ticket IDs and timestamps (populate columns: ticket_id, status, closed_at, owner).  
2) short slide mapping critical/high findings to SOC 2 CC controls (we'll attach to the summary).  
3) a one-page NDA draft (attached) for FintechCorp legal to review. Monica will review the redactions to ensure no PoCs or internal IP are leaked.

Vivek, please confirm two 60-minute slots next week (Aug 3 and Aug 4) 10:00–11:00 PST and 14:00–15:00 PST. If either conflicts, propose alternates.

-Monica
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

From: alyssa.grant@fintechcorp.com <alyssa.grant@fintechcorp.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: security@fintechcorp.com, procurement@fintechcorp.com
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vulnerability assessment report request (FintechCorp)

Sojin / Monica / Hannah —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and for offering the controlled review. Procurement will also route an NDA; happy to sign Redwood's draft if that's faster. We can take the 10:00–11:00 PST slot on Aug 4 for the on-screen review. Please send the meeting invite and any pre-read materials (SOC 2 mapping slide, remediation tracker with ticket IDs).

One note from audit: if any finding remains open after Aug 4, we need a written remediation ETA included in the tracker.

Appreciate the collaboration.

Best,
Alyssa
Head of Information Security
FintechCorp
